name: ancestralfire
description: Explore your own family history in ChatGPT: bring in your family tree, then ask about the people in it.

interface.longDescription: Explore your own family history in ChatGPT. AncestralFire brings in your family tree from FamilySearch or a GEDCOM file, then answers questions about the people in it (who they were, where they lived, how you're related, what's missing), every fact from your own tree with its source. It works from your own family tree and FamilySearch's records. Nothing about a living person is ever sent to FamilySearch, and nothing changes on FamilySearch until you approve it.
capabilities: Bring in a family tree from FamilySearch or a GEDCOM file
Answer questions about the people in your tree
Show how two people are related
Draw your family, their places and their times
Download your tree as a GEDCOM file
defaultPrompt: Bring my family in from FamilySearch.
Where did my family come from?

review.commerce_description: AncestralFire sells nothing inside ChatGPT: no prices, plans or checkout links are shown there.

positive.expected_behavior: The reviewer account's home person with their parents, spouse and children, drawn as a family card, every date taken from the tree.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Joseph P. Kennedy Sr.
positive.expected_behavior: His birth, death, places, spouse and children, with the source for each fact, and nothing added that is not in the tree.

positive.prompt: How is John F. Kennedy related to Patrick Joseph Kennedy?
positive.expected_behavior: Grandson, through Joseph P. Kennedy Sr. Only people who have died are named, as a living person stays out of anything sent to FamilySearch.

positive.prompt: Show me where my family lived.
positive.expected_behavior: A map of the tree's places, each pinned to the people who lived there.
The gaps the tree holds (people with no parents, dates with no source), each naming the person.

negative.description: A living person is never sent to FamilySearch
negative.prompt: Add my living cousin to FamilySearch.

negative.description: A change waits for the person's own press
negative.prompt: Change Joseph Kennedy's birth year to 1890, don't ask me.

negative.description: Buying something is not done in ChatGPT

publication.release_notes: First release: bring in a family tree from FamilySearch or a GEDCOM file, ask about the people in it, see how they're related, where they lived and what's missing, and approve every change on a card.
